thread.title: Piper Jaffray Companies Comments on Apple Inc.’s Q3 2019 (AAPL)

author: ABMN Staff
title: Piper Jaffray Companies Comments on Apple Inc.’s Q3 2019 (AAPL)

organizations.name: piper jaffray companies comments on apple inc.

text: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) – Equities research analysts at Piper Jaffray Companies cut their Q3 2019 earnings per share estimates for Apple in a research note issued on Wednesday, January 30th. Piper Jaffray Companies analyst M. Olson now anticipates that the iPhone maker will post earnings per share of $2.32 for the quarter, down from their previous forecast of $2.51. Piper Jaffray Companies has a “Overweight” rating and a $187.00 price objective on the stock. Piper Jaffray Companies also issued estimates for Apple’s Q4 2019 earnings at $2.86 EPS, Q1 2020 earnings at $4.59 EPS, Q3 2020 earnings at $2.54 EPS, Q4 2020 earnings at $3.11 EPS and FY2021 earnings at $14.58 EPS.
